provenance: OpenAI o3 as previewed 20 Dec 2024 (announcement figures, scored by OpenAI, model unreleased at the time; documented publicly in the ARC Prize o3 write-up). AIME 2024 96.7%, GPQA Diamond 87.7%, SWE-bench Verified 71.7% vs o1's 48.9%, Codeforces rating 2727. Points encode the SWE-bench Verified jump: x=0 is o1, x=1 is o3. The later measurement in El-Kishky et al. 2025 (arXiv:2502.06807) puts o3 at 2724 Codeforces Elo (99.8th percentile) — on simulated contests mirroring real competitions, held out past both data cut-offs, not live entries — consistent with the announced 2727.
